scripts.dev: (cd packages/shared && npm run build) && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,server,client "(cd packages/shared && npm run dev)" "(cd apps/server && npm run dev)" "(cd apps/client && npm run dev)"
scripts.build: (cd packages/shared && npm run build) && (cd apps/server && npm run build) && (cd apps/client && npm run build)
scripts.typecheck: (cd packages/shared && npm run build) && (cd packages/shared && npm run typecheck) && (cd apps/server && npm run typecheck) && (cd apps/client && npm run typecheck) && tsc --project tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: (cd packages/shared && npm run build) && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/shared/src/*.test.ts apps/server/src/*.test.ts && node --test scripts/update-staged-docs.test.mjs scripts/factory-smoke.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
